extractions.label: bravery_bonuses
extractions.expression: (() => { const levels = idleon.getAttr("Holes")[15]; const coefficients = idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h.HolesInfo[37]; const fountain = 1 + idleon.callFunction("Holes2", "Fountain_BonTOT", 0, 13) / 100; const self = idleon.callFunction("Holes", "MonumentROGbonuses", 0, 9); const cosmo = idleon.callFunction("Holes", "CosmoBonusQTY", 0, 0); return Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => { const coefficient = Number(coefficients[0 + i]); const multiplier = Math.max(1, (i === 9 ? 1 : 1 + self / 100 + cosmo / 100) * fountain); const bonus = idleon.callFunction("Holes", "MonumentROGbonuses", 0, i); const capped = coefficient >= 30; const bonusCap = capped ? coefficient * multiplier : null; return { level: Number(levels[0 + i]), bonus, perLevelIncrement: capped ? null : coefficient, bonusCap, capTargetLevel: capped ? Math.ceil(250 * (10 * coefficient * multiplier - 1)) : null, progressPercent: capped ? bonus / bonusCap * 100 : null }; }); })()
extractions.description: Native bonus values and saved levels. Cap, target, and progress replay competitor domain semantics from bravery.ts:53-70 using native coefficients and multipliers; target is not the first level reached by native ceiling rounding.

extractions.label: bravery_unlocks
extractions.description: Removed monument bricks grant effects; accumulated hours alone do not unlock effects.
